title: Module:Skilltree
text:
local p = {} -- {{Skilltree|Sorcery}}: the skill tree window of the game. The combat skills in a 4 wide grid, the passives with -- their numbers, and (a click on the eye) the Abyssal skills and the Abyssal passive. A skill shows its card when the -- pointer rests on it, a passive its text. Everything is for a player of level 55. -- The data of the trees: Module:Skilltree/data. The skills: Module:Skill (Module:Data/SkillCards/...). -- The Abyssal toggle is the standard collapsible of MediaWiki (mw-customtoggle / mw-customcollapsible), no script of -- our own is needed. The sprite sheet File:Ability_change.png holds the eye icon. local Data = require('Module:Skilltree/data') local Skill = require('Module:Skill') local IconName = require('Module:IconName') local Store = require('Module:DataStore') local Tooltip = require('Module:Tooltip') local SPRITE = 'Ability_change.png' local function trim(s) return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or '')) end local function yes(v) v = trim(v):lower() return v == 'yes' or v == 'y' or v == '1' or v == 'true' or v == 'on' end -- text with {orange} words, one line per \n. [[buff:15031]] shows the buff as {{BuffLink|15031}} (icon, name, card on hover) local function rich(parent, text, class, tg) for _, ln in ipairs(mw.text.split(text, '\n')) do local html = mw.text.encode(ln, '<>&"\'') html = html:gsub('{(.-)}', '%1') html = html:gsub('%[%[buff:(%d+)%]%]', function(id) return mw.getCurrentFrame():expandTemplate{ title = 'BuffLink', args = { id } } end) parent:tag(tg or 'div'):addClass(class):wikitext(html) end end local function icon(file, size) local f = IconName.iconFile(file) if f == '' then return '' end return '[[File:' .. f .. '|' .. size .. 'px|link=]]' end -- a piece of the sprite sheet (the CSS crops it) local function sprite(class) return '[[File:' .. SPRITE .. '|384px|link=]]' end local function override(c, defstat) if type(c) ~= 'table' then return nil end local ov = { mana = c.mana or 0, cast = (c.cast or 0) * 1000, cd = (c.cd or 0) * 1000, rad = c.eff or 0, chan = c.chan and c.chan * 1000 or nil, minr = c.minr or 0, maxr = c.range or 0, caster = c.caster and true or nil, charges = c.charges, desc = c.desc, bdur = c.bdur, channeled = c.channeled and true or nil } if type(c.bdur) == 'table' then local t = {} for k, v in pairs(c.bdur) do t[k] = v * 1000 end ov.bdur = t end if c.ma then ov.dmg = { { pct = c.ma, stat = c.stat or defstat or 'Magic Attack', fmin = c.flat or 0, fmax = c.flat or 0 } } else ov.dmg = {} end return ov end local function skillTile(parent, id, col, ranks, ovs) local tile = parent:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-tile aa-tree-col' .. col):attr('tabindex', '0') -- icon + card, from Module:Skill: the icon changes with the version / chain card chosen in the box local card = Skill.tip(id, ranks, ovs) if card == '' or card:find('&"\'')) tip:tag(tg):addClass('aa-tree-sep') rich(tip, ps.text, 'aa-tree-ptext', tg) if ps.note then tip:tag(tg):addClass('aa-tree-sep') rich(tip, ps.note, 'aa-tree-ptext', tg) end if need then tip:tag(tg):addClass('aa-tree-sep') -- the game: "Learning Req.: Sorcery 2 or higher" = this many skill points spent in the tree open the passive rich(tip, 'Unlocks once {' .. need .. '} skill points are spent in ' .. tree .. '.', 'aa-tree-ptext', tg) rich(tip, 'Learning it costs 1 skill point.', 'aa-tree-ptext', tg) end end -- the passive of a tile of the tree: the box that opens on hover local function passiveTip(tile, ps, tree, need) ptipBox(tile:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-tip'):tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-ptip'), ps, tree, need) end -- the tree called name (any capitalisation): its real name and its data local function findTree(name) local want = trim(name):lower() for k, v in pairs(Data) do if k:lower() == want then return k, v end end end -- the stylesheets of the links and cards (one tag per page is enough, so the pages that make many links add them once) local function allStyles(frame) return frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:Skill/styles.css' }) .. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:SkillLink/styles.css' }) .. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:Skilltree/styles.css' }) end -- the numbers of a tree for the cards of its skills (made once per tree and page) local ovsCache = {} local function treeOvs(t) if ovsCache[t] == nil then local ovs = {} for cid, c in pairs(t.cards or {}) do ovs[cid] = override(c, t.stat) if type(c.boost) == 'table' then ovs[cid].boost = override(c.boost, t.stat) end end ovsCache[t] = ovs end return ovsCache[t] end -- Lazy cards: the link carries only the icon, the name and where its card comes from (data-sid, data-tree). The card itself is fetched by -- MediaWiki:Common.js (block "Lazy skill cards") when the pointer first rests on the link, by {{#invoke:Skilltree|card|id|Tree}} below. -- That keeps a page with many skill links small. Set LAZY to false to put every card in the page again (no script needed then). local LAZY = true -- one skill in a line: the icon and the name, and the card of the tree on hover. opts.size, opts.left, opts.notip, opts.tname (the tree, -- needed for a lazy card), opts.inline (the card in the page, whatever LAZY says). -- It is made here and not by {{SkillLink}}, so a page with many links is not counted again for every template around it. local function skillHtml(id, t, opts) if Store.get('SkillCards', id) == nil then return '' end local root = mw.html.create('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip') if opts.left then root:addClass('aa-skilltip-left') end root:wikitext(Skill.link{ args = { id = id, size = opts.size and tostring(opts.size) or nil } }) if not opts.notip then if LAZY and opts.tname and not opts.inline then root:addClass('aa-lazy'):attr('data-sid', tostring(id)):attr('data-tree', opts.tname) root:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip-card') else local card = Skill.treecard(id, t and t.ranks, t and treeOvs(t) or nil, 'l') root:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip-card'):wikitext(Tooltip.flat{ args = { card } }) end end return tostring(root) end -- {{#invoke:Skilltree|card|10752|Sorcery}}: the card of a lazy skill link (the same card the link used to carry). Common.js fetches it -- with action=parse when the pointer first rests on the link. function p.card(frame) local id = tonumber(trim(frame.args[1])) local _, t = findTree(frame.args[2]) if not id or not t or Store.get('SkillCards', id) == nil then return '' end local card = Skill.treecard(id, t.ranks, treeOvs(t), 'l') return '
' .. Tooltip.flat{ args = { card } } .. '
' end -- one passive of a tree in a line: the icon and the name, and the box of the passive on hover. pname = the name or the number. local function passiveHtml(tname, t, pname, opts) pname = trim(pname):lower() local ps, need for _, x in ipairs(t.passives or {}) do if x.name:lower() == pname or tostring(x.num) == pname then ps, need = x, x.num end end if not ps and t.abyssalPassive and t.abyssalPassive.name:lower() == pname then ps = t.abyssalPassive end if not ps then return 'PassiveLink: no passive "' .. mw.text.encode(pname) .. '" in ' .. tname .. '' end local size = tonumber(opts.size) or 22 local root = mw.html.create('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip') if opts.left then root:addClass('aa-skilltip-left') end root:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip-ico'):css({ width = size .. 'px', height = size .. 'px' }):wikitext(icon(ps.icon, size)) root:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip-name'):wikitext(mw.text.encode(ps.name, '<>&"\'')) if not opts.notip then ptipBox(root:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip-card'):tag('span'):addClass('aa-tree-ptip'), ps, tname, need, 'span') end return tostring(root) end -- {{PassiveLink|Sorcery|Mana Flurry}}: a passive of a tree in a line of text, as {{SkillLink}} does for a skill: the icon and the -- name, and the box of the tree (the same text) opens on hover. 1 = the tree, 2 = the name of the passive (or its number). function p.passive(frame) local a = frame:getParent() and frame:getParent().args or frame.args local tname, t = findTree(a[1]) if not t then return 'PassiveLink: unknown tree "' .. mw.text.encode(trim(a[1])) .. '"' end local tip = trim(a.tip):lower() local html = passiveHtml(tname, t, a[2], { size = a.size, left = tip == 'left', notip = tip == 'no' }) return frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:SkillLink/styles.css' }) .. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:Skilltree/styles.css' }) .. html end -- {{SkillLink|10752|tree=Sorcery}}: a skill in a line of text, as {{SkillLink}}, but its card has the numbers and the rank of the -- tree (mana, range, cast time, damage formula ...) from Module:Skilltree/data, the same card as the tile of the tree. function p.skill(frame) local a = frame:getParent() and frame:getParent().args or frame.args local id = tonumber(trim(a[1])) local tname, t = findTree(a.tree) if not id then return '' end local tip = trim(a.tip):lower() local html = skillHtml(id, t, { size = a.size, left = tip == 'left', notip = tip == 'no', tname = tname, inline = trim(a.lazy):lower() == 'no' }) if html:find('^TreeSkills: unknown tree "' .. mw.text.encode(trim(a[1])) .. '"' end local function sk(id) return skillHtml(id, t, { size = 32, tname = tname }) end local function pa(name) return passiveHtml(tname, t, name, { size = 32 }) end local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-ts') local n = 0 if what == 'combat' then root:addClass('aa-ts-combat') for _, id in ipairs(t.combat or {}) do root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-ts-item'):wikitext(sk(id)) n = n + 1 end elseif what == 'passives' or what == 'passive' then root:addClass('aa-ts-passives') for _, x in ipairs(t.passives or {}) do local it = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-ts-item') it:tag('span'):addClass('aa-ts-pts'):attr('title', 'Points needed in ' .. tname):wikitext(tostring(x.num)) it:wikitext(pa(x.name)) n = n + 1 end elseif what == 'abyssal' then root:addClass('aa-ts-abyssal') for _, id in ipairs(t.abyssal or {}) do root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-ts-item'):wikitext(sk(id)) n = n + 1 end if t.abyssalPassive and t.abyssalPassive.name then local it = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-ts-item') it:wikitext(pa(t.abyssalPassive.name)) it:tag('span'):addClass('aa-ts-tag'):wikitext('Passive') n = n + 1 end else return 'TreeSkills: the second value must be combat, passives or abyssal' end if n == 0 then return '' end return allStyles(frame) .. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:TreeSkills/styles.css' }) .. tostring(root) end -- the icons of the trees on File:Skill.png (the numbers of the Main Page) local TREEICON = { Battlerage = 1, Sorcery = 2, Archery = 3, Vitalism = 4, Shadowplay = 5, Auramancy = 6, Defense = 7, Songcraft = 9, Witchcraft = 10, Occultism = 11 } -- {{TreeCombo|tree=Songcraft|role=Extra damage|Damage|passive Zeal, buff 771|Perform songs|10723, 10724}}: a card for a tree that pairs -- well with the tree of the page. After tree and role come pairs of a label and a list of things, separated by commas. A thing is a skill -- id (10723), a passive (passive Zeal) or a buff (buff 771). Things joined by + stay together (buff 127 + 10710). -- The whole card is made here, so the page is not counted again for the templates around every link. function p.combo(frame) local a = frame:getParent() and frame:getParent().args or frame.args local tname, t = findTree(a.tree) if not t then return 'TreeCombo: unknown tree "' .. mw.text.encode(trim(a.tree)) .. '"' end local function thing(tok) tok = trim(tok) local id = tok:match('^(%d+)$') if id then return skillHtml(tonumber(id), t, { tname = tname }) end local b = tok:match('^buff%s+(%d+)$') if b then return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'BuffLink', args = { b } } end local pn = tok:match('^passive%s+(.+)$') if pn then return passiveHtml(tname, t, pn, {}) end return 'TreeCombo: unknown "' .. mw.text.encode(tok) .. '"' end local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-tc') local head = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-head') head:tag('span'):addClass('aa-tc-ico aa-ic-' .. (TREEICON[tname] or 0)):wikitext('[[File:Skill.png|link=' .. tname .. '|alt=]]') local title = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-title') title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-name'):wikitext('[[' .. tname .. ']]') title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-role'):wikitext(mw.text.encode(trim(a.role), '<>&')) local rows local n = 1 while a[n] ~= nil do local label, list = trim(a[n]), trim(a[n + 1]) if list ~= '' then rows = rows or root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-rows') local row = rows:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-row') row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-tc-lbl'):wikitext(mw.text.encode(label, '<>&')) local items = row:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-items') for _, tok in ipairs(mw.text.split(list, ',')) do if tok:find('%+') then local grp = items:tag('span') for i, part in ipairs(mw.text.split(tok, '+', true)) do if i > 1 then grp:wikitext(' + ') end grp:wikitext(thing(part)) end elseif trim(tok) ~= '' then items:wikitext(thing(tok)) end end end n = n + 2 end return allStyles(frame) .. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:TreeCombo/styles.css' }) .. tostring(root) end -- an empty layer after the tiles of a grid: while one of the tiles is clicked open (focus) it covers the whole tree, so the -- other tiles cannot be hovered and their cards cannot open on top of the open one; a click on it closes the card local function shield(grid) grid:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-shield') end function p.tree(frame) local pf = frame:getParent() local a = pf and pf.args or frame.args local want = trim(a[1]):lower() local name, t for k, v in pairs(Data) do if k:lower() == want then name, t = k, v end end local styles = frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:Skill/styles.css' }) .. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:Skilltree/styles.css' }) if not t then return styles .. 'Skilltree: unknown tree "' .. mw.text.encode(trim(a[1])) .. '"' end local open = yes(a.abyssal) local ovs = {} -- the numbers of the skills (and of their versions) by skill id for id, c in pairs(t.cards or {}) do ovs[id] = override(c, t.stat) if type(c.boost) == 'table' then ovs[id].boost = override(c.boost, t.stat) end -- the numbers with the rank item (+1) end local key = name:lower():gsub('[^%w]', '') local idTop, idBottom = 'aa-abyss1-' .. key, 'aa-abyss2-' .. key local function collapsible(parent, id) local box = parent:tag('div'):addClass('mw-collapsible'):attr('id', 'mw-customcollapsible-' .. id) if not open then box:addClass('mw-collapsed') end return box end -- where the tree sits on the page (float) and so where the boxes open: to the right of a tree on the left -- of the page, to the left of a tree on the right (tips = left or right overrides it) local float = trim(a.float):lower() local tips = trim(a.tips):lower() if tips ~= 'left' and tips ~= 'right' then tips = (float == 'right') and 'left' or 'right' end local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-tree aa-tree-tips-' .. tips) if float == 'right' then root:attr('style', 'float:right; clear:right; margin:0 0 3.5em 3.5em;') elseif float == 'left' then root:attr('style', 'float:left; clear:left; margin:0 3.5em 3.5em 0;') elseif float == 'center' then root:attr('style', 'display:table; margin:0 auto 0.5em auto;') end -- combat root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-name'):wikitext(mw.text.encode(name, '<>&"\'')) local head = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-head') head:tag('span'):addClass('aa-tree-title'):wikitext('Combat') local grid = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-grid') for i, id in ipairs(t.combat) do skillTile(grid, id, (i - 1) % 4 + 1, t.ranks, ovs) end shield(grid) if t.abyssal and #t.abyssal > 0 then -- the space of the row stays when it is closed: the collapsible only hides the content wrapper inside it. The -- eye (toggle) comes after the collapsible, so the CSS can show it grey while that one is collapsed. local wrap = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-aby') local box = collapsible(wrap, idTop):tag('div'):addClass('mw-collapsible-content') local g2 = box:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-grid') for i, id in ipairs(t.abyssal) do skillTile(g2, id, (i - 1) % 4 + 1, t.ranks, ovs) end shield(g2) wrap:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-eye mw-customtoggle-' .. idTop .. ' mw-customtoggle-' .. idBottom) :attr('title', 'Abyssal skills') :wikitext(sprite('aa-eye-on') .. sprite('aa-eye-off') .. sprite('aa-eye-hover')) end -- passives root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-head aa-tree-head-p'):tag('span'):addClass('aa-tree-title'):wikitext('Passive') local pg = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-grid') for i, ps in ipairs(t.passives or {}) do local col = (i - 1) % 4 + 1 local tile = pg:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-tile aa-tree-col' .. col):attr('tabindex', '0') tile:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-ico'):wikitext(icon(ps.icon, 56)) passiveTip(tile, ps, name, ps.num) end shield(pg) if t.abyssalPassive then local box = collapsible(root, idBottom):addClass('aa-tree-abp') -- the space stays when it is closed: only the content wrapper is hidden by the collapsible local g3 = box:tag('div'):addClass('mw-collapsible-content'):tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-grid') local tile = g3:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-tile aa-tree-col1'):attr('tabindex', '0') tile:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-ico'):wikitext(icon(t.abyssalPassive.icon, 56)) passiveTip(tile, t.abyssalPassive, name, nil) shield(g3) end -- logo watermark in the bottom right corner root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-mark'):wikitext('[[File:Logo.png|170px|link=]]') return styles .. tostring(root) end return p

<pre><code>local p = {}

-- {{Skilltree|Sorcery}}: the skill tree window of the game. The combat skills in a 4 wide grid, the passives with
-- their numbers, and (a click on the eye) the Abyssal skills and the Abyssal passive. A skill shows its card when the
-- pointer rests on it, a passive its text. Everything is for a player of level 55.
-- The data of the trees: Module:Skilltree/data. The skills: Module:Skill (Module:Data/SkillCards/...).
-- The Abyssal toggle is the standard collapsible of MediaWiki (mw-customtoggle / mw-customcollapsible), no script of
-- our own is needed. The sprite sheet File:Ability_change.png holds the eye icon.
local Data = require('Module:Skilltree/data')
local Skill = require('Module:Skill')
local IconName = require('Module:IconName')
local Store = require('Module:DataStore')
local Tooltip = require('Module:Tooltip')

local SPRITE = 'Ability_change.png'

local function trim(s)
	return mw.text.trim(tostring(s or ''))
end

local function yes(v)
	v = trim(v):lower()
	return v == 'yes' or v == 'y' or v == '1' or v == 'true' or v == 'on'
end

-- text with {orange} words, one line per \n. [[buff:15031]] shows the buff as {{BuffLink|15031}} (icon, name, card on hover)
local function rich(parent, text, class, tg)
	for _, ln in ipairs(mw.text.split(text, '\n')) do
		local html = mw.text.encode(ln, '<>&"\'')
		html = html:gsub('{(.-)}', '<span class="aa-tree-hl">%1</span>')
		html = html:gsub('%[%[buff:(%d+)%]%]', function(id)
			return mw.getCurrentFrame():expandTemplate{ title = 'BuffLink', args = { id } }
		end)
		parent:tag(tg or 'div'):addClass(class):wikitext(html)
	end
end

local function icon(file, size)
	local f = IconName.iconFile(file)
	if f == '' then return '' end
	return '[[File:' .. f .. '|' .. size .. 'px|link=]]'
end

-- a piece of the sprite sheet (the CSS crops it)
local function sprite(class)
	return '<span class="aa-tree-spr ' .. class .. '">[[File:' .. SPRITE .. '|384px|link=]]</span>'
end

local function override(c, defstat)
	if type(c) ~= 'table' then return nil end
	local ov = { mana = c.mana or 0, cast = (c.cast or 0) * 1000, cd = (c.cd or 0) * 1000, rad = c.eff or 0, chan = c.chan and c.chan * 1000 or nil,
		minr = c.minr or 0, maxr = c.range or 0, caster = c.caster and true or nil, charges = c.charges, desc = c.desc,
		bdur = c.bdur, channeled = c.channeled and true or nil }
	if type(c.bdur) == 'table' then
		local t = {}
		for k, v in pairs(c.bdur) do t[k] = v * 1000 end
		ov.bdur = t
	end
	if c.ma then
		ov.dmg = { { pct = c.ma, stat = c.stat or defstat or 'Magic Attack', fmin = c.flat or 0, fmax = c.flat or 0 } }
	else
		ov.dmg = {}
	end
	return ov
end

local function skillTile(parent, id, col, ranks, ovs)
	local tile = parent:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-tile aa-tree-col' .. col):attr('tabindex', '0')
	-- icon + card, from Module:Skill: the icon changes with the version / chain card chosen in the box
	local card = Skill.tip(id, ranks, ovs)
	if card == '' or card:find('<!%-%-') then
		tile:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-ico'):wikitext('?')
	else
		tile:wikitext(card)
	end
end

-- the box of a passive: icon, "Passive Skill", name, text, what it needs
local function ptipBox(tip, ps, tree, need, tg)
	tg = tg or 'div'      -- 'span' in a line of text ({{PassiveLink}}): a div in a span would end the paragraph
	local head = tip:tag(tg):addClass('aa-tree-phead')
	head:tag(tg):addClass('aa-tree-picon'):wikitext(icon(ps.icon, 40))
	local title = head:tag(tg):addClass('aa-tree-ptitle')
	title:tag(tg):addClass('aa-tree-pkind'):wikitext('Passive Skill')
	title:tag(tg):addClass('aa-tree-pname'):wikitext(mw.text.encode(ps.name, '<>&"\''))
	tip:tag(tg):addClass('aa-tree-sep')
	rich(tip, ps.text, 'aa-tree-ptext', tg)
	if ps.note then
		tip:tag(tg):addClass('aa-tree-sep')
		rich(tip, ps.note, 'aa-tree-ptext', tg)
	end
	if need then
		tip:tag(tg):addClass('aa-tree-sep')
		-- the game: "Learning Req.: Sorcery 2 or higher" = this many skill points spent in the tree open the passive
		rich(tip, 'Unlocks once {' .. need .. '} skill points are spent in ' .. tree .. '.', 'aa-tree-ptext', tg)
		rich(tip, 'Learning it costs 1 skill point.', 'aa-tree-ptext', tg)
	end
end

-- the passive of a tile of the tree: the box that opens on hover
local function passiveTip(tile, ps, tree, need)
	ptipBox(tile:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-tip'):tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-ptip'), ps, tree, need)
end

-- the tree called name (any capitalisation): its real name and its data
local function findTree(name)
	local want = trim(name):lower()
	for k, v in pairs(Data) do
		if k:lower() == want then return k, v end
	end
end

-- the stylesheets of the links and cards (one tag per page is enough, so the pages that make many links add them once)
local function allStyles(frame)
	return frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:Skill/styles.css' })
		.. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:SkillLink/styles.css' })
		.. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:Skilltree/styles.css' })
end

-- the numbers of a tree for the cards of its skills (made once per tree and page)
local ovsCache = {}
local function treeOvs(t)
	if ovsCache[t] == nil then
		local ovs = {}
		for cid, c in pairs(t.cards or {}) do
			ovs[cid] = override(c, t.stat)
			if type(c.boost) == 'table' then ovs[cid].boost = override(c.boost, t.stat) end
		end
		ovsCache[t] = ovs
	end
	return ovsCache[t]
end

-- Lazy cards: the link carries only the icon, the name and where its card comes from (data-sid, data-tree). The card itself is fetched by
-- MediaWiki:Common.js (block "Lazy skill cards") when the pointer first rests on the link, by {{#invoke:Skilltree|card|id|Tree}} below.
-- That keeps a page with many skill links small. Set LAZY to false to put every card in the page again (no script needed then).
local LAZY = true

-- one skill in a line: the icon and the name, and the card of the tree on hover. opts.size, opts.left, opts.notip, opts.tname (the tree,
-- needed for a lazy card), opts.inline (the card in the page, whatever LAZY says).
-- It is made here and not by {{SkillLink}}, so a page with many links is not counted again for every template around it.
local function skillHtml(id, t, opts)
	if Store.get('SkillCards', id) == nil then return '<!-- SkillLink: this skill is not stored yet, run sync_wiki_data.py --scan -->' end
	local root = mw.html.create('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip')
	if opts.left then root:addClass('aa-skilltip-left') end
	root:wikitext(Skill.link{ args = { id = id, size = opts.size and tostring(opts.size) or nil } })
	if not opts.notip then
		if LAZY and opts.tname and not opts.inline then
			root:addClass('aa-lazy'):attr('data-sid', tostring(id)):attr('data-tree', opts.tname)
			root:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip-card')
		else
			local card = Skill.treecard(id, t and t.ranks, t and treeOvs(t) or nil, 'l')
			root:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip-card'):wikitext(Tooltip.flat{ args = { card } })
		end
	end
	return tostring(root)
end

-- {{#invoke:Skilltree|card|10752|Sorcery}}: the card of a lazy skill link (the same card the link used to carry). Common.js fetches it
-- with action=parse when the pointer first rests on the link.
function p.card(frame)
	local id = tonumber(trim(frame.args[1]))
	local _, t = findTree(frame.args[2])
	if not id or not t or Store.get('SkillCards', id) == nil then return '' end
	local card = Skill.treecard(id, t.ranks, treeOvs(t), 'l')
	return '<div class="aa-lazy-card">' .. Tooltip.flat{ args = { card } } .. '</div>'
end

-- one passive of a tree in a line: the icon and the name, and the box of the passive on hover. pname = the name or the number.
local function passiveHtml(tname, t, pname, opts)
	pname = trim(pname):lower()
	local ps, need
	for _, x in ipairs(t.passives or {}) do
		if x.name:lower() == pname or tostring(x.num) == pname then ps, need = x, x.num end
	end
	if not ps and t.abyssalPassive and t.abyssalPassive.name:lower() == pname then ps = t.abyssalPassive end
	if not ps then return '<span class="error">PassiveLink: no passive "' .. mw.text.encode(pname) .. '" in ' .. tname .. '</span>' end
	local size = tonumber(opts.size) or 22
	local root = mw.html.create('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip')
	if opts.left then root:addClass('aa-skilltip-left') end
	root:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip-ico'):css({ width = size .. 'px', height = size .. 'px' }):wikitext(icon(ps.icon, size))
	root:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip-name'):wikitext(mw.text.encode(ps.name, '<>&"\''))
	if not opts.notip then
		ptipBox(root:tag('span'):addClass('aa-skilltip-card'):tag('span'):addClass('aa-tree-ptip'), ps, tname, need, 'span')
	end
	return tostring(root)
end

-- {{PassiveLink|Sorcery|Mana Flurry}}: a passive of a tree in a line of text, as {{SkillLink}} does for a skill: the icon and the
-- name, and the box of the tree (the same text) opens on hover. 1 = the tree, 2 = the name of the passive (or its number).
function p.passive(frame)
	local a = frame:getParent() and frame:getParent().args or frame.args
	local tname, t = findTree(a[1])
	if not t then return '<span class="error">PassiveLink: unknown tree "' .. mw.text.encode(trim(a[1])) .. '"</span>' end
	local tip = trim(a.tip):lower()
	local html = passiveHtml(tname, t, a[2], { size = a.size, left = tip == 'left', notip = tip == 'no' })
	return frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:SkillLink/styles.css' })
		.. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:Skilltree/styles.css' }) .. html
end

-- {{SkillLink|10752|tree=Sorcery}}: a skill in a line of text, as {{SkillLink}}, but its card has the numbers and the rank of the
-- tree (mana, range, cast time, damage formula ...) from Module:Skilltree/data, the same card as the tile of the tree.
function p.skill(frame)
	local a = frame:getParent() and frame:getParent().args or frame.args
	local id = tonumber(trim(a[1]))
	local tname, t = findTree(a.tree)
	if not id then return '' end
	local tip = trim(a.tip):lower()
	local html = skillHtml(id, t, { size = a.size, left = tip == 'left', notip = tip == 'no', tname = tname, inline = trim(a.lazy):lower() == 'no' })
	if html:find('^<!%-%-') then return html end
	return frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:Skill/styles.css' })
		.. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:SkillLink/styles.css' }) .. html
end

-- {{TreeSkills|Sorcery|combat}} (or passives, abyssal): the skills of a tree as a tidy grid of skill links / passive links with the
-- numbers of the tree. combat = the 12 combat skills, passives = the passives with the points they need, abyssal = the Abyssal skills
-- and the Abyssal passive. Everything comes from Module:Skilltree/data, so a new skill or passive is added in one place only.
function p.skills(frame)
	local a = frame:getParent() and frame:getParent().args or frame.args
	local what = trim(a[2]):lower()
	local tname, t = findTree(a[1])
	if not t then return '<span class="error">TreeSkills: unknown tree "' .. mw.text.encode(trim(a[1])) .. '"</span>' end
	local function sk(id) return skillHtml(id, t, { size = 32, tname = tname }) end
	local function pa(name) return passiveHtml(tname, t, name, { size = 32 }) end
	local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-ts')
	local n = 0
	if what == 'combat' then
		root:addClass('aa-ts-combat')
		for _, id in ipairs(t.combat or {}) do
			root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-ts-item'):wikitext(sk(id))
			n = n + 1
		end
	elseif what == 'passives' or what == 'passive' then
		root:addClass('aa-ts-passives')
		for _, x in ipairs(t.passives or {}) do
			local it = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-ts-item')
			it:tag('span'):addClass('aa-ts-pts'):attr('title', 'Points needed in ' .. tname):wikitext(tostring(x.num))
			it:wikitext(pa(x.name))
			n = n + 1
		end
	elseif what == 'abyssal' then
		root:addClass('aa-ts-abyssal')
		for _, id in ipairs(t.abyssal or {}) do
			root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-ts-item'):wikitext(sk(id))
			n = n + 1
		end
		if t.abyssalPassive and t.abyssalPassive.name then
			local it = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-ts-item')
			it:wikitext(pa(t.abyssalPassive.name))
			it:tag('span'):addClass('aa-ts-tag'):wikitext('Passive')
			n = n + 1
		end
	else
		return '<span class="error">TreeSkills: the second value must be combat, passives or abyssal</span>'
	end
	if n == 0 then return '' end
	return allStyles(frame) .. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:TreeSkills/styles.css' }) .. tostring(root)
end

-- the icons of the trees on File:Skill.png (the numbers of the Main Page)
local TREEICON = { Battlerage = 1, Sorcery = 2, Archery = 3, Vitalism = 4, Shadowplay = 5, Auramancy = 6, Defense = 7, Songcraft = 9, Witchcraft = 10, Occultism = 11 }

-- {{TreeCombo|tree=Songcraft|role=Extra damage|Damage|passive Zeal, buff 771|Perform songs|10723, 10724}}: a card for a tree that pairs
-- well with the tree of the page. After tree and role come pairs of a label and a list of things, separated by commas. A thing is a skill
-- id (10723), a passive (passive Zeal) or a buff (buff 771). Things joined by + stay together (buff 127 + 10710).
-- The whole card is made here, so the page is not counted again for the templates around every link.
function p.combo(frame)
	local a = frame:getParent() and frame:getParent().args or frame.args
	local tname, t = findTree(a.tree)
	if not t then return '<span class="error">TreeCombo: unknown tree "' .. mw.text.encode(trim(a.tree)) .. '"</span>' end
	local function thing(tok)
		tok = trim(tok)
		local id = tok:match('^(%d+)$')
		if id then return skillHtml(tonumber(id), t, { tname = tname }) end
		local b = tok:match('^buff%s+(%d+)$')
		if b then return frame:expandTemplate{ title = 'BuffLink', args = { b } } end
		local pn = tok:match('^passive%s+(.+)$')
		if pn then return passiveHtml(tname, t, pn, {}) end
		return '<span class="error">TreeCombo: unknown "' .. mw.text.encode(tok) .. '"</span>'
	end
	local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-tc')
	local head = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-head')
	head:tag('span'):addClass('aa-tc-ico aa-ic-' .. (TREEICON[tname] or 0)):wikitext('[[File:Skill.png|link=' .. tname .. '|alt=]]')
	local title = head:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-title')
	title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-name'):wikitext('[[' .. tname .. ']]')
	title:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-role'):wikitext(mw.text.encode(trim(a.role), '<>&'))
	local rows
	local n = 1
	while a[n] ~= nil do
		local label, list = trim(a[n]), trim(a[n + 1])
		if list ~= '' then
			rows = rows or root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-rows')
			local row = rows:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-row')
			row:tag('span'):addClass('aa-tc-lbl'):wikitext(mw.text.encode(label, '<>&'))
			local items = row:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tc-items')
			for _, tok in ipairs(mw.text.split(list, ',')) do
				if tok:find('%+') then
					local grp = items:tag('span')
					for i, part in ipairs(mw.text.split(tok, '+', true)) do
						if i > 1 then grp:wikitext(' + ') end
						grp:wikitext(thing(part))
					end
				elseif trim(tok) ~= '' then
					items:wikitext(thing(tok))
				end
			end
		end
		n = n + 2
	end
	return allStyles(frame) .. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:TreeCombo/styles.css' }) .. tostring(root)
end

-- an empty layer after the tiles of a grid: while one of the tiles is clicked open (focus) it covers the whole tree, so the
-- other tiles cannot be hovered and their cards cannot open on top of the open one; a click on it closes the card
local function shield(grid)
	grid:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-shield')
end

function p.tree(frame)
	local pf = frame:getParent()
	local a = pf and pf.args or frame.args
	local want = trim(a[1]):lower()
	local name, t
	for k, v in pairs(Data) do
		if k:lower() == want then name, t = k, v end
	end
	local styles = frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:Skill/styles.css' })
		.. frame:extensionTag('templatestyles', '', { src = 'Template:Skilltree/styles.css' })
	if not t then
		return styles .. '<span class="error">Skilltree: unknown tree "' .. mw.text.encode(trim(a[1])) .. '"</span>'
	end

	local open = yes(a.abyssal)
	local ovs = {}      -- the numbers of the skills (and of their versions) by skill id
	for id, c in pairs(t.cards or {}) do
		ovs[id] = override(c, t.stat)
		if type(c.boost) == 'table' then ovs[id].boost = override(c.boost, t.stat) end      -- the numbers with the rank item (+1)
	end
	local key = name:lower():gsub('[^%w]', '')
	local idTop, idBottom = 'aa-abyss1-' .. key, 'aa-abyss2-' .. key
	local function collapsible(parent, id)
		local box = parent:tag('div'):addClass('mw-collapsible'):attr('id', 'mw-customcollapsible-' .. id)
		if not open then box:addClass('mw-collapsed') end
		return box
	end

	-- where the tree sits on the page (float) and so where the boxes open: to the right of a tree on the left
	-- of the page, to the left of a tree on the right (tips = left or right overrides it)
	local float = trim(a.float):lower()
	local tips = trim(a.tips):lower()
	if tips ~= 'left' and tips ~= 'right' then tips = (float == 'right') and 'left' or 'right' end
	local root = mw.html.create('div'):addClass('aa-tree aa-tree-tips-' .. tips)
	if float == 'right' then
		root:attr('style', 'float:right; clear:right; margin:0 0 3.5em 3.5em;')
	elseif float == 'left' then
		root:attr('style', 'float:left; clear:left; margin:0 3.5em 3.5em 0;')
	elseif float == 'center' then
		root:attr('style', 'display:table; margin:0 auto 0.5em auto;')
	end

	-- combat
	root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-name'):wikitext(mw.text.encode(name, '<>&"\''))
	local head = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-head')
	head:tag('span'):addClass('aa-tree-title'):wikitext('Combat')
	local grid = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-grid')
	for i, id in ipairs(t.combat) do skillTile(grid, id, (i - 1) % 4 + 1, t.ranks, ovs) end
	shield(grid)
	if t.abyssal and #t.abyssal > 0 then
		-- the space of the row stays when it is closed: the collapsible only hides the content wrapper inside it. The
		-- eye (toggle) comes after the collapsible, so the CSS can show it grey while that one is collapsed.
		local wrap = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-aby')
		local box = collapsible(wrap, idTop):tag('div'):addClass('mw-collapsible-content')
		local g2 = box:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-grid')
		for i, id in ipairs(t.abyssal) do
			skillTile(g2, id, (i - 1) % 4 + 1, t.ranks, ovs)
		end
		shield(g2)
		wrap:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-eye mw-customtoggle-' .. idTop .. ' mw-customtoggle-' .. idBottom)
			:attr('title', 'Abyssal skills')
			:wikitext(sprite('aa-eye-on') .. sprite('aa-eye-off') .. sprite('aa-eye-hover'))
	end

	-- passives
	root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-head aa-tree-head-p'):tag('span'):addClass('aa-tree-title'):wikitext('Passive')
	local pg = root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-grid')
	for i, ps in ipairs(t.passives or {}) do
		local col = (i - 1) % 4 + 1
		local tile = pg:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-tile aa-tree-col' .. col):attr('tabindex', '0')
		tile:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-ico'):wikitext(icon(ps.icon, 56))
		passiveTip(tile, ps, name, ps.num)
	end
	shield(pg)
	if t.abyssalPassive then
		local box = collapsible(root, idBottom):addClass('aa-tree-abp')
		-- the space stays when it is closed: only the content wrapper is hidden by the collapsible
		local g3 = box:tag('div'):addClass('mw-collapsible-content'):tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-grid')
		local tile = g3:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-tile aa-tree-col1'):attr('tabindex', '0')
		tile:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-ico'):wikitext(icon(t.abyssalPassive.icon, 56))
		passiveTip(tile, t.abyssalPassive, name, nil)
		shield(g3)
	end
	-- logo watermark in the bottom right corner
	root:tag('div'):addClass('aa-tree-mark'):wikitext('[[File:Logo.png|170px|link=]]')
	return styles .. tostring(root)
end
